description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ALL data types for a company (Codat re-pulls from the connected source platforms). Asynchronous: it enqueues pulls, it does not return the data. Use codat_get_data_status to track progress. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/all.
name: codat_refresh_all_data
title: Queue a full data refresh
